construct: glyph markup whose value sets are RAGGED across two axes — one glyph on the (plain,sm)/(marked,lg) diagonal, two others on the opposite one
why: THE ANTI-LOOSENING GUARD for svg-glyph-two-axis. Carrying a rectangular conjunction must NOT become 'carry any multi-axis glyph'. A diagonal correlation is a DISJUNCTION: the value sets of the shared glyph span the whole grid, so any visibleWhen + stylesWhen rectangle would draw it in cells the library gives a DIFFERENT glyph. The whole asset must still refuse under its ORIGINAL name and the host must still promote as a box.

canvas.note: a disjunctive glyph correlation has no contract spelling; the host draws as an empty box and the refusal is named
